title: Write an aesthetic service's consent
summary: Its own consent text, with patient, doctor and service variables, and a preview.

steps.title: Menu → Sales → Services
steps.details: Each aesthetic service can have its own consent.

steps.title: Choose the service
steps.details: Tap it to open its record.

steps.title: Aesthetics
steps.details: If it is not there, first mark the service as an aesthetic service in Details.

steps.title: Consent
steps.details: Without its own text, the generic one is used. Changing it only affects new signatures: what's already signed stays as it was.

steps.title: Start from the generic one
steps.details: Loads the generic text to edit it. It only appears when the text is empty.

steps.title: Text
steps.details: What the patient sees before signing.

steps.title: Variables
steps.details: Replaced when signing: patient, doctor, service, product and date. An unknown variable prevents saving.

steps.title: Preview
steps.details: How it looks with sample data.
